tool_input.command: for f in package.json index.html pigment.app.json README.md src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

sed -i 's/var(--space-48, var(--space-40))/var(--space-40)/g; s/  .hero-window { width: 100%; max-width: var(--size-form); margin-top: calc(-1 \* var(--space-40)); position: relative; }/  .hero-window { width: 100%; max-width: var(--size-form); margin-top: var(--space-24); }/' src/styles/base.css && grep -n "space-48\|hero-window {" src/styles/base.css
tool_input.description: Replace non-token spacing and hero window offset

tool_input.command: npm install 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; npm run typecheck
